dialogues.speaker: Yasmin
dialogues.text: Hmm, it's alright. There's nothing wrong with the Divine Tree's roots.

dialogues.speaker: Yasmin
dialogues.text: Are you talking about that potion we sprinkled around the last time?

dialogues.speaker: Yasmin
dialogues.text: Hmm... Ladep and Pharez are still trying to make adjustments.

dialogues.speaker: Yasmin
dialogues.text: The effect was good indeed, but the "physiolocial emetic" that Ladep added really made other people quite uncomfortable.

dialogues.speaker: Yasmin
dialogues.text: And I don't know why, but this potion also attracts Fungi.

dialogues.speaker: Yasmin
dialogues.text: I hope Ladep can come up with an improved formula soon...

dialogues.speaker: Yasmin
dialogues.text: I'll probably need your help again when I sprinkle the potion next time. Please lend me a hand by then.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are the two of them okay?

dialogues.speaker: Yasmin
dialogues.text: Regarding their academic achievements, they are very happy now. They've collected empirical data, and their research turned out to be fruitful.

dialogues.speaker: Yasmin
dialogues.text: But in terms of their everyday lives, they weren't even eating anymore, and their sleep patterns were terribly skewed...

dialogues.speaker: Yasmin
dialogues.text: In their own words... This is the price of doing research.
